about_the_game:
The investigation has just begun. Join in and see where it leads you.

A suspense-driven point & click adventure.

As Special Agent Sarah Young, you take on a case where the stakes are the capture of a dangerous terrorist.

🕵️ Investigation

Special Agent Sarah Young leads an investigation aimed at capturing a dangerous terrorist who could threaten all of New York City.

The case quickly proves to be more complex than it first appears. Every location, conversation, and discovered item may matter — but not all of them lead in the right direction.

The gameplay is based on classic point & click, in an “old-school” style, where many environmental elements and interactions are available. Some are crucial to the investigation, while others may distract and make it harder to draw the right conclusions. It’s up to the player to decide which leads are truly important.

The game features an extensive storyline, hand-painted visuals, and a system of choices that appear throughout the investigation.

🔍 Key Features

• Classic point & click gameplay in a retro style
• Numerous interactions and elements that can distract the course of the investigation
• Hand-painted graphics
• Original, memorable soundtrack
• Interesting achievements to unlock
• A touch of humor from the agent leading the investigation

🗣️ Agent Sarah’s Comment

"I have three days to save New York City from destruction. If you want to help me, I’ll expect your full cooperation. Together, we’ll have to make difficult decisions — not only related to the investigation. This is serious, so you’ll need to keep a cool head…"
